messages:
Leah: quick sync — recurring OOMs on shard-11, looks like KV residency creeping up after many small writes. Need owners and short timeline.
Sam: noted. I see slab fragmentation signals + increased eviction misses.
Ravi: can we get an immediate heap snapshot and enable alloc tracing for one canary node?
Leah: yes. command: `curl http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).pprof` — run now.
Jules: I'll spin up a canary with `slab_coalesce=true` on two nodes, but will keep traffic low.
Sam: add soft per-shard residency limit so it triggers eviction before OOM. config: `residency.soft_limit_bytes=0.8 * shard_capacity`.
Ravi: I'll upload pprof artifacts to artifacts.redwood once captured.
infra-bot: Runbook link added: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-oom-mitigation (owners: Leah, Sam).
oncall-bot: Oncall this week: Jules.
Leah: action items: A1 (Ravi) heap + alloc traces uploaded by EOD; A2 (Sam) canary config and slot by 09:00 tomorrow; A3 (Jules) dashboard with frag-signature alert >15% on 5m avg by 08:30. reconvene 24h after canary start.
Sam: noted. I'll make rollback criteria: tail latency increase >5% or memory slope >20% over 1h.
Jules: will monitor CPU, coalescing can spike CPU. set autoscaler buffer.
Leah: thanks — closing for now, post updates here as they happen.
